independent_exact_computation.ambient_space: orthonormal e_1,...,e_5 with roots of squared length 2
independent_exact_computation.positive_roots: e_i-e_j and e_i+e_j for every 1<=i<j<=5 (20 positive roots)

formulae.highest_weight: lambda=sum_i a_i*omega_i for Dynkin labels a_i

independent_exact_computation.independence_note: Dimensions, Casimirs and indices were independently computed from the explicit D5 roots above, not inferred from source dimension labels. Repository dual_weight and representation_type were separately cross-checked against these roots, the real vector/exterior-square constructions, and the inequivalent spinor weights.

embedding_and_chirality_check.omega4_weights: All (s1,...,s5)/2 with s_i=+/-1 and an odd number of minus signs
embedding_and_chirality_check.SM_check: For LH SM fields Q,u^c,e^c, the source Z=-4*T_R^3+6*T_BL gives +1; L,d^c give -3 and nu^c gives +5. Thus source16_F corresponds to omega4 in this explicitly fixed embedding, not omega5.
embedding_and_chirality_check.126_check: Sym^2(omega4 spinor) has highest weight2*omega4 and contains the symmetric product of the Z=+5 singlets, hence a Z=+10 singlet. The source TableII and16_F16_F126_H* agree. The dimension check gives126 for this highest weight; Sym^2(16) has136 dimensions and splits into126+10.
embedding_and_chirality_check.warning: 16 versus bar16 is not determined by dimension16; neither is126 versus its conjugate. The explicit embedding fixes these source-to-atlas labels. A D5 outer automorphism would also conjugate the embedding and all representations, not silently relabel just one Weyl row.

scalar_counting_checks.real45: Adjoint45 is a real-type irrep; the source297-dimensional mass matrix establishes one source real45, not an arbitrary choice based on type alone.
scalar_counting_checks.complex126: 126 and its dual are inequivalent complex irreps but define the same underlying real scalar module. One source complex126 gives one real module of dimension252. The canonical lexicographically larger representative is[0,0,0,2,0].
scalar_counting_checks.complex10: Vector10 is real type, but the source field10_H is unconstrained complex in the selected full regime. It contributes two real10 modules, not one and not20 copies.
scalar_counting_checks.normalizer_crosscheck: normalize_spec(source-candidate) exactly equals the staged field-content-2 candidate; scalar conversions yield multiplicities1,1,2 and leave the Weyl16_F label[0,0,0,1,0] with multiplicity3 unchanged. canonicalize only calls scalar orientation on real_module rows.

three_family_crosscheck.basis: SM-generation inheritance corroborated by the source b=-12, not a literal printed3x16 inventory table
three_family_crosscheck.warning: The printed b=-12 applies to the complex10 extension only. It corroborates the ordinary three-family baseline subsequently inherited by the minimal model; it is not a printed beta coefficient of the just45+126 model. This is a counting cross-check of the specified source field set, not an anomaly, viability or intake gate.

minimal_model_source_reconciliation.source_basis: After a renewed inspection of the complete p.11 image and surrounding source text, SectionIV.A explicitly discusses the model whose Higgs sector contains just45H and126H and writes its16F f12616F126H* Yukawa interaction. The stated deficiency is flavour phenomenology, not an absent matter completion. Thus it is source-supported to describe this full minimal gauge-matter inventory; this is distinct from pretending that the scalar-only SectionII analysis itself supplied fermions.
minimal_model_source_reconciliation.no_viability_gate: The source's unrealistic mixing/spectrum objection is a source claim retained in provenance. The atlas has no phenomenological viability gate, so this objection does not prevent intake of the explicitly described gauge-matter model.
minimal_model_source_reconciliation.generation_count_basis: Three ordinary SM families unified in16F are an explicit declared inheritance convention for this concrete entry. SectionIV.A discusses the same ordinary fermionic SM flavour sector in the minimal and extended Yukawa models. There is no literal3x16 inventory table on p.11. The extended model's b=-12 independently corroborates that shared source family baseline but must not be presented as a beta coefficient printed for the minimal model.
minimal_model_source_reconciliation.minimal_beta_exact_calculation: -(11/3)*8+(1/6)*8+(1/3)*35+(2/3)*2*3=-37/3; adding a complex10 scalar contributes+1/3 and gives-12 for the extended model.
minimal_model_source_reconciliation.normalizer_check: normalize_spec(new minimal source-candidate) exactly equals its new field-content-2 normalized candidate, with three rows and unchanged LH omega4 fermions. The fingerprint above was recomputed using canonicalize.
